Rashi on Temurah 15b:1:1.hebrew: כיוצא בו - לא איתפרש היכא קאי:
Rashi on Temurah 15b:1:1.english: Similarly to it - It is not explained to what [earlier statement] this refers.

Rashi on Temurah 15b:2:1.english: But is a sin offering sacrificed as a burnt offering? - As it is written: "and twelve he-goats as a sin offering; all of it a burnt offering" (Ezra 8:35).

Tosafot on Temurah 15b:1:1.hebrew: כיוצא בו אמר ר' יוסי - פרש"י: לא איתפרש היכא קאי. הכי תניא בת"כ, על ההיא דדריש האי קרא דכתיב גבי [עולה ויורד] (ויקרא ה׳:י׳): "ואת השני יעשה עולה" — מה עולה אינה נאכלת, אף חטאת זו אינה נאכלת. ועלה מיתניא היא:
Tosafot on Temurah 15b:1:1.english: "Similarly, Rabbi Yosei said" - Rashi explained: It is not explained where this [baraita] stands. This is what is taught in the Torat Kohanim, on that [baraita] which expounds this verse that is written regarding [the sliding-scale offering] (Leviticus 5:10): "And the second he shall make a burnt offering" — just as a burnt offering is not eaten, so too this sin offering is not eaten. And it is taught on that [very verse]:
